messages:
Amelia (Product): proposing a 'shadow adoption' lane for new catalog entries. idea: route ~5-10% of live requests to candidate model purely for quality comparison (no billing), run for 7-14 days, then decide pin/unpin. thoughts?

Sanjay (Eng-ML): I like shadowing for signal. main costs: KV cache priming + extra GPU cycles. 5% seems fine for most tenants but heavy tenants could blow ops budget. need autoscale + cost cap.

Maya (Platform): +1 but we need a safe guardrail: shadow traffic must be sampled at prefix/route level (not full-tenant) and should honor batching policies to avoid tail latency blowups. also need rollout config:
```
canary:
  cohort: 5%
  duration_days: 10
  metrics: [core_eval_passrate, safety_fail_rate, p95_latency]
  abort_if: core_eval_passrate_drop > 3% OR safety_fail_rate_increase > 0.5%
```

Ian (Customer-Success): customers asked for explicit pin durations. typical asks: 90-day pin, unlimited for enterprise contract. if we auto-unpin after shadow-pass + 30 days, we should surface the opt-out and an SLA add-on. customers hate surprise moves.

Amelia (Product): agree re: transparency. proposal: default pin TTL = 30 days after promotion, with optional customer opt-in (90/180/forever) as a paid contract. auto-unpin only if customer hasn't set longer pin and model flagged for retirement. we also need quality rollback gates.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): quality gates suggestion: run a holdout eval set (200 samples stratified by tenant traffic) + live A/B on top queries. pass criteria:
- core_eval parity >= 97% relative to incumbent on holdout
- safety_fail_rate delta <= 0.3%
- p95 latency increase <= 10%
If any fail -> canary fail -> do not auto-promote.

Maya (Platform): infra ops: add a throttled shadow queue and a billing-exempt marker. we'll implement prefix-level sampling and provide an admin toggle per-model. note: shard affinity for KV cache may skew results, add bias-aware correction in analysis.

Ian (Customer-Success): comms plan:
- 2-week pre-cutover note for customers on pinned models
- in-console banner for tenants in the canary cohort
- exportable report after 10 days with pass/fail and sample diffs
This helps customers escalate if they see regressions.

Amelia (Product): customer-visible controls we should expose in Console:
- pin duration dropdown (30/90/180/forever)
- prefer-incumbent toggle (block auto-promote)
- request evaluation report button
Also add a simple CTA: "Request extended pin" (creates sales ticket).

Sanjay (Eng-ML): one more: for metrics we should version the eval harness to tie to model binary. store scores + seeds so regressions are auditable.

Maya (Platform): ops-bot integration: when canary finishes we should auto-generate a runbook snippet and a deploy-bot summary. ops-bot: can you create a template?

ops-bot: created template: `/runbook create canary-summary --cohort 5% --duration 10d --metrics core_eval,safety,p95_latency`

Amelia (Product): risks: 1) customers with strict pins will need manual migration paths, 2) shadowing cost needs to be budgeted into Dedicated pricing tiers, 3) false negatives from skewed sampling. mitigation: explicit escape hatch, billing credits for canaries, and stratified sampling.

Ian (Customer-Success): customer ask: make the exported report highlight exact prompts that regressed + model outputs side-by-side. that wins trust.

Amelia (Product): next steps / action items:
- Sanjay: prototype eval-parity check (due: 2024-08-09)
- Maya: infra sampling + ops-bot template (due: 2024-08-16)
- Ian: draft comms + console wording (due: 2024-08-12)
I'll take ownership of spec doc and pricing note. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:

Maya (Platform): :thumbsup: small caveat on the 5% for enterprise tenants, might need 1-2% default to limit cost.

Ian (Customer-Success): :thumbsup: will validate wording with a pilot customer tomorrow.

Amelia (Product): thanks all — aiming to lock spec in 1 week. if no objections by 2024-07-30 I'll move to PR for roadmap.
